intuition: The robot follows one deterministic cycle around the rectangular boundary, so large step counts can be reduced modulo the perimeter.

brute_force.approach: Simulate every attempted step and turn counterclockwise whenever the next cell is outside the grid.

optimal.approach: Track total movement modulo the perimeter and map the resulting boundary index to a coordinate and heading.

edge_cases: The initial state faces East, but returning to the origin after movement faces South.
A turn occurs only when an attempted step would leave the grid.
